text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Economic outlook for Gulf Cooperation Council states bright despite resumption of Iraqi oil exports, says former head of Bahrain Petroleum Company (BAPCO).
- Gulf Cooperation Council agrees to raise custom duties on tobacco to 70 percent in the new year from 50 percent.
- Qatar signs a 12-year $570 million loan with four foreign banks to finance gas export project.
- Bahrain, Kuwait and Muscat are set to sign an agreement to link their bourses.
- Bahrain to build a specialised hospital at a cost of 10 million dinars in 1997.
